question: The POCSO Act 2012 applies only to female children under 18 years and cannot be invoked when the complainant is a male child.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. POCSO Act 2012 is gender-neutral. It protects all persons under 18 years of age from sexual offences, regardless of their gender. The Act uses the term 'child' broadly and the examining doctor must apply POCSO provisions regardless of the victim's gender.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this is false. POCSO is explicitly a gender-neutral statute that protects all children irrespective of gender. A 'child' is defined as any person under 18 years of age. Male, female, and transgender children are all protected under POCSO.
